bitbucket-repos 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Enables browsing Bitbucket repositories, managing branches, reviewing pull requests, and coordinating repository workflows through ClawLink integration.
- Uses ClawLink to handle authentication and tool access, so no manual Bitbucket API setup is required.
- Includes clear setup and usage instructions for connecting Bitbucket via ClawLink and discovering available tools.
- Emphasizes secure handling of credentials and confirmation before performing write or destructive actions.
